abstract:
Cosmos-Predict1 is a collection of general-purpose world foundation models for Physical AI that can be fine-tuned into customized world models for downstream applications.

> [!IMPORTANT] > ## 🚀 [Cosmos 3 Has Arrived](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Cosmos) > > Cosmos 3 is NVIDIA's next-generation foundation model platform for Physical AI. Compared with Cosmos-Predict1, Cosmos 3 delivers significantly stronger world prediction capabilities, producing more accurate, coherent, and physically grounded future-state predictions across a wide range of environments and embodiments. > > Beyond improving prediction quality, Cosmos 3 unifies capabilities that previously required multiple specialized models. A single Cosmos 3 model can reason, predict future world states, transfer across domains and modalities, and generate actions and policies for embodied agents within one unified architecture. > > This repository is no longer under active development and will receive only limited maintenance updates. Future model releases, features, documentation, and community support will be focused on Cosmos 3. > > 👉 Visit the new Cosmos home: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Cosmos > > There you will find the latest Cosmos 3 models, technical reports, tutorials, benchmarks, and ecosystem updates. > > Thank you for your support of Cosmos-Predict1. We encourage all users to migrate to Cosmos 3 for the latest state-of-the-art Physical AI capabilities. ### [Product Website](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai/cosmos/) | [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos-predict1-67c9d1b97678dbf7669c89a7) | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03575) | [Paper Website](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/dir/cosmos-predict1) Cosmos-Predict1 is a key branch of Cosmos World Foundation Models (WFMs) specialized for future state prediction, often referred to as world models. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：以大规模视频数据预训练通用世界基础模型（WPM），同时给出扩散式（Diffusion）和自回归式（Autoregressive）两条技术路线，支持文本/图像条件下的未来视频帧预测，并可通过微调适配具体具身与物理 AI 应用（如 Video2World 图像到未来视频）。


# 一、动机

> 面向 Physical AI 缺乏通用「世界模型」的问题：此前视频生成模型多针对视觉质量而非物理合理性，且难以迁移到机器人等具体具身场景。Cosmos-Predict1 希望提供一个可在大规模视频上预训练、再微调成下游定制世界模型的通用基础模型。


# 二、方法

> 以大规模视频数据预训练通用世界基础模型（WPM），同时给出扩散式（Diffusion）和自回归式（Autoregressive）两条技术路线，支持文本/图像条件下的未来视频帧预测，并可通过微调适配具体具身与物理 AI 应用（如 Video2World 图像到未来视频）。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文报告 Cosmos-Predict1 包含扩散与自回归两类模型，参数规模覆盖 4B/7B/12B/14B，训练数据量级为约 2000 万小时视频（约 9000 万亿 token）；作者称其生成结果在物理合理性与 3D 一致性等人类评估上优于同期开源视频生成基线，并可作为下游世界模型微调起点。需注意：官方仓库已停止活跃开发，功能与文档支持转向 Cosmos 3，后者宣称在预测准确性、连贯性和物理一致性上显著更强并统一了推理、预测、跨域迁移与动作/策略生成能力。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限在于：Cosmos-Predict1 本身是仓库/模型卡性质的项目页，缺少针对真实机器人闭环控制的详细量化验证，且已被官方标记为不再积极维护，长期使用建议迁移到 Cosmos 3。启发是：世界模型作为「预训练 + 下游微调」范式，可为具身智能提供可复用的动力学先验，但物理一致性与动作可用性（能否直接驱动策略）仍是关键待验证点；与本课题的相关性取决于是否将视频世界模型用于机器人规划或数据增广环节。
